title: IPCC AR6: equilibrium climate sensitivity is likely 2.5°C to 4°C
summary: The Summary for Policymakers gives a best estimate of 3°C, a likely range of 2.5°C to 4°C, and a very likely range of 2°C to 5°C. The headline page had stated the best estimate without this interval.
body: An existing card quotes the AR6 headline statements, including a best estimate of equilibrium climate sensitivity of 3°C, and it says the headline page did not print the full likely interval. The Summary for Policymakers itself, statement A.4.4, does. It says equilibrium climate sensitivity is a quantity used to estimate how the climate responds to radiative forcing. Based on multiple lines of evidence, the very likely range is between 2°C, at high confidence, and 5°C, at medium confidence. The assessed best estimate is 3°C, with a likely range of 2.5°C to 4°C, at high confidence, compared with 1.5°C to 4.5°C in the previous assessment, which did not provide a best estimate. This card adds that interval from the summary. It does not replace the headline card.
